dandanku/gather-fodder-wool.instruction: Gather grain, straw and coloured wool
dandanku/gather-fodder-wool.logic: The fodder and wool are gathered for Iyarri’s horses and attendants.

dandanku/mix-fodder.logic: The grain and straw become one mixture.

dandanku/scatter-fodder.instruction: Scatter the fodder across the road
dandanku/scatter-fodder.logic: The mixture is placed on the road for the god’s horses.

dandanku/address-grooms.instruction: Ask Iyarri’s grooms to feed his horses
dandanku/address-grooms.logic: The accompanying words assign the scattered fodder to Iyarri’s horses.

dandanku/address-maids.instruction: Ask the god’s maids to take the coloured wool
dandanku/address-maids.logic: The same address assigns the wool to the god’s attendants.

paskuwatti/make-reed-gate.logic: The gate defines the threshold for the offerant’s passage.

paskuwatti/bind-gate.instruction: Bind the gate with red and white wool
paskuwatti/bind-gate.logic: The prepared gate is bound before the crossing.

paskuwatti/give-spindle.instruction: Place a spindle and distaff in the offerant’s hands
paskuwatti/give-spindle.logic: The implements are held during the passage.

paskuwatti/pass-gate.logic: The offerant crosses while holding the implements.

paskuwatti/exchange-implements.instruction: Exchange the spindle and distaff for a bow and arrows
paskuwatti/exchange-implements.logic: The first implements are taken away and new ones are given.

paskuwatti/speak-exchange.logic: Paškuwatti’s words give the exchange its stated meaning.

zarpiya/take-implements.logic: The implements are gathered before the threshold is closed.

zarpiya/close-door.logic: The door becomes the boundary for the concluding act.

zarpiya/anoint-door.instruction: Anoint the door with fine oil
zarpiya/anoint-door.logic: Oil is applied to the closed threshold.

zarpiya/speak-formula.instruction: Speak the words asking that evil stay outside and good remain within
zarpiya/speak-formula.logic: The accompanying words explain the closing and anointing.

zelliya/take-funerary-goods.instruction: Take the named goods for the dead
zelliya/take-funerary-goods.logic: The clothing, furniture, vessels, food and valuable objects are gathered for the dead person.

zelliya/prepare-funerary-goods.logic: The listed goods are prepared before the later funerary actions.

zelliya/carry-dead-outside.logic: The body is brought outside after a damaged intervening passage.

zelliya/cremate-dead.logic: The carried body is cremated, completing its stated disposition.

tapalazunauli/bring-donkey.logic: The donkey is introduced as a carrier for the unwanted condition.

tapalazunauli/assign-evil.instruction: Tell the donkey to carry off the evil
tapalazunauli/assign-evil.logic: The spoken assignment gives the animal its role as a carrier.

tapalazunauli/send-donkey.instruction: Drive the donkey toward enemy land
tapalazunauli/send-donkey.logic: The carrier is sent away with the evil it has been asked to bear.

tapalazunauli/scatter-straw.logic: Straw begins the provision that will be taken outside.

tapalazunauli/break-bread.logic: Bread joins the straw in the material provision.

tapalazunauli/fill-basket.instruction: Put the materials in a basket
tapalazunauli/fill-basket.logic: The prepared materials are gathered into one carrier for removal.

tapalazunauli/chant-at-gate.logic: The woman’s ritual cry accompanies the basket as it leaves.

tapalazunauli/carry-basket-out.instruction: Carry the basket across the boundary
tapalazunauli/carry-basket-out.logic: The carrier is taken out of the house and across the gate.

tapalazunauli/speak-to-god.instruction: Speak of food brought for the god and his dogs
tapalazunauli/speak-to-god.logic: The words identify the basket’s contents as food for the addressed recipients.
